options.description: You ask in ordinary language, for example 'regenerate my resume', and the agent runs the rebuild. You do not need to remember a command. Recommended: Asking in plain words is the least effort for you and matches your request to regenerate easily, while still letting you decide when a rebuild happens.
options.label: Plain words to the agent (Recommended)

options.description: You run one named command in the terminal. The agent does nothing until you run it, and you need to remember the command name.
options.label: A command you run yourself

options.description: Each time you save an edited Markdown file, the rebuild runs by itself. Nothing is rebuilt if you prefer to check first.
options.label: Automatic on save
